proposed_comments.title: Coordinate cleanup with every CommandItemViewModel publication path
proposed_comments.body:
### Coordinate cleanup with every CommandItemViewModel publication path

**Severity:** `high`

The cleanup gate needs to linearize with all state publication, not only the initial callback checks. The current implementation still allows an in-flight initialization, property callback, derived-attribute update, or synthetic context-item update to resume after cleanup has won and repopulate the cleaned view model or raise follow-on notifications. Please coordinate the lifecycle transition with the guarded publication sections (or use an equivalent linearizable commit protocol), and cover the late-callback cases with lifecycle tests.

proposed_comments.title: Discard stale command callbacks before publishing the synthetic context item
proposed_comments.body:
### Discard stale command callbacks before publishing the synthetic context item

**Severity:** `high`

Two overlapping Command-changed callbacks can capture different extension command models. Before publishing the default context item, validate under the publication lock that the captured command model is still the model owned by the current CommandViewModel; otherwise discard the stale callback. Without that identity check, the synthetic item can retain model B while borrowing command C, and invoking it can send the current command with stale context.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The identity check belongs inside the coordinated publication block, but the current upstream diff does not expose a stable RIGHT-side range for this fork-only correction.
